title: Review realistic live flashlight lighting stabilization
objective: Review Builder changes for the live realistic flashlight mode. Focus on whether the implementation addresses live brightness drift while preserving realistic Lumen GI/reflections/material response, whether default behavior remains compatible, whether Unreal reflection/property fallbacks are safe against resolveProperty crashes, whether the new cafeteria teleop command is correct, and whether tests cover the change.

artifacts: Live realistic flashlight mode now suppresses local exposure, warms up before teleop control, keeps Lumen GI/reflections/material response enabled, and uses the realistic_live_flashlight profile with inverse-square fallback support.

expected_outputs: Findings first with file/line references. Explicitly state whether runtime Experimenter validation is needed before user use.
definition_of_done: Inspector has reviewed changed files and tests, identified any blocking correctness/runtime risks, and provided a pass/fail recommendation for the live cafeteria teleop command.
